assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production BACKGROUND texture for a landscape 2D physics archery game, wide panoramic 16:9 composition, ideally 2048x1152. Create an immersive hand-painted 'Storm Ruins' sky sanctuary: immense ancient ruined aqueduct arches on distant cliff islands, blue-green mountains receding through mist, a few tiny aged bronze architectural accents and restrained cyan rune lights. Polished stylized game painting, broad shapes, painterly stone, strong atmospheric depth, sophisticated teal/navy palette with soft warm dusk light from upper left. IMPORTANT gameplay layout: center 70 percent of image is calm open mid-dark blue-green mist/sky, low contrast behind small ivory/teal/red characters and gold arrows. Architecture frames far left and far right; horizon and distant ruins concentrated below lower third; no bright sun disk behind gameplay, no high-frequency stone detail across center. Full bleed opaque image. Environment only: no characters, no weapons, no arrows, no foreground playable platforms, no ground plane spanning center, no UI, no text, no border, no watermark. Rich scenic immersion while keeping small projectile silhouettes very readable.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PLATFORM sprite for the same Storm Ruins 2D side-view game. One horizontal ancient stone-and-bronze floating ledge, front orthographic elevation, wide approximately 5:1 silhouette, single complete object centered with generous fully transparent margin. Broad pale worn stone top lip is perfectly straight and horizontal; rectangular blue slate front fascia has large carved stone joints, two aged bronze end brackets and a single small inset turquoise diamond rune at center. Subtle moss only in shallow crevices, warm upper-left rim light, deep navy lower edge, softly hand-painted premium 2D game art. Same cool teal/navy, aged bronze and restrained cyan palette as a ruined sky sanctuary at dusk. The entire SOLID object must fit one low rectangular strip, uniform height: no rocks, roots, ivy, chains or rubble hanging below, no tall grass above the level top surface. No perspective top plane, no isometric view, no ground shadow, no scenery, no characters, no typography, no labels, no baked checkerboard. Genuine transparent alpha outside the single ledge. Aim for 1536x512 wide image; object occupies central 90 percent width and approximately 54 percent image height.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production TRANSPARENT modular character sprite atlas, 4 columns by 3 rows of equal cells, ideally 2048x1536. ONE atlas for an original teal Storm Ruins archer, clean orthographic side-view body cutouts designed for a physics ragdoll. Premium hand-painted stylized 2D game art with crisp dark navy contour, large readable light/shadow planes, warm ivory skin, blue-green short tunic, aged bronze tiny fasteners, brown leather belt, teal wrist guards and dark teal boot cuffs. Compact simple round head with short dark hair and a tiny side-profile face looking RIGHT, no helmet or hood covering the silhouette. No loose cape/scarf or long hair. More crafted and tactile than a flat stick figure, still clean and readable when the assembled figure is 70 pixels tall. ALL components SEPARATE, centered in their own equal cell with at least 15 percent transparent padding. Limbs straight, long axis vertical with round centered attachment ends; no elbows or knees bent into L shapes, no limbs joined, no hands sticking sideways or wide feet. Mandatory EXACT order, left to right: row 1: round HEAD alone; CHEST/tunic alone without arms or neck; compact PELVIS/belt piece alone; LEFT UPPER ARM alone. Row 2: LEFT FOREARM alone; RIGHT UPPER ARM alone; RIGHT FOREARM alone; LEFT THIGH alone. Row 3: LEFT SHIN alone; RIGHT THIGH alone; RIGHT SHIN alone; EMPTY transparent cell. Head circular. Chest ratio width:height 0.48:0.65, pelvis 0.42:0.34, upper arms 0.20:0.40, forearms 0.18:0.38, thighs 0.22:0.56, shins 0.20:0.58. Each piece follows these anatomical proportions, no decorative oversize. Light from upper left across every piece. Genuine transparent background, no floor shadows, no grid lines, no cell borders, no letters, no numbering, no labels, no weapons, no full assembled figure.
